lesson: The system failed by attempting to buy into local exhaustion (RSI > 80) and misinterpreting 4h bearish structure as mere absorption. Both trades ignored the reality of mean reversion, leading to entries at local tops rather than structural support.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'Cooling-Off' rule: prohibit long entries on ZECUSDT if the 1h RSI is above 70, regardless of higher timeframe bullish structure.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based overbought signals more than structural bullish bias during high-volatility extensions.
